findings.claim: The change silently clamps out-of-range priorities instead of raising InvalidPriorityError, directly contradicting the invariant (INV-2) documented in the function's own docstring immediately above it, which states the invariant exists specifically to prevent a caller from believing a request for priority 9 was honored when it was actually capped.
findings.failure_scenario: enqueue(queue, 't1', 99) now returns a Task with priority=9 and no error, whereas a caller relying on the documented contract (and the still-present InvalidPriorityError class) would expect an exception; a caller that intended priority 99 as a signal of misconfiguration gets silently treated as priority 9 with no indication the value was altered.
